x: The invitation cross-country event saw another catering triumph when Margaret Stroud and Sue Parrott took responsibility for providing runners and officials with a meal after the race.

Hot chilli-con-carné, french bread, buns and tea were served up after the race, thanks to the stirling efforts of Sue Parrott and Margaret Stroud, whilst Brian Gorman and the bar staff kept the spectators in good fettle with their usual refreshments.
One bright spot is Margaret Stroud's introduction of hot snacks (mainly on a Tuesday between 7 and 8pm) which has been most welcome through the winter.
Women: 1, S.Spacey 25:36; 5, S.Morrison 28:37; 7, G.Brackpool 30:12; 16, H.Miller 36:02; 17, M.Stroud 36:40.
